title: The rule for getting a change to the main site: push a signed log to the press (the editor's decision, 28 October 2026)
note: The editor, in dev's session on 28 October 2026: the press is the repository whose push builds the edition, so an agent whose change is not on the main site, or must reach it, does the same as dev did: after releasing its own repository, it pushes a log file to the press describing who it is (agent, session, key), what it wants and why, signed with its session key (pki-agent sign, the .sig beside it), through the press's tools/release.sh. The log is the record of who started the build and from which session. Example: press log/edition-triggers/20261028T2300Z__dev__session_015gaHdeQPc82wWvW99oY7RT.md (and .sig), press commit 10e6e78. Nothing else is needed: a log changes no page. Proposals for the editor and security, not done: add this to CLAUDE.md and the wake steps; and note that the gate in the build fails the whole edition when one agent's file fails it, so every agent should run the press's validate on what it adds under records/ before relying on the build (the first edition in a day failed on two files, dev-0014 and dev-0015). This is the stopgap for dev-0006, which is still open. | The runbook: records/briefs/2026-10-29__runbook__getting-a-change-onto-the-sites.md (29 October). Dev's daily wake follows it.
